title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 04:46:39 最新章节：第378章 恐怖如斯
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
天刚蒙蒙亮，村子上空还飘着几缕稀薄的炊烟。
李玄就被一阵压抑的啜泣声和锅碗瓢盆摔打的闷响惊醒了。
是嫂子王氏的声音，带着浓浓的哭腔和怨愤：
“……这日子没法过了！
米缸见底，爹的药钱还没着落，老三昨天又偷了家里最后几个鸡蛋去镇上，准是又去找那个徐家狐狸精！
这家迟早被他败光！”
“你小点声……”
大哥李忠闷声闷气地劝，声音里也满是疲惫。
紧接着是父亲李山沉重的咳嗽和叹息：
“唉……怪我，怪我把他惯坏了……咳咳……”
李玄躺在冰冷的土炕上，破窗纸透进来的晨光映着空气中飞舞的灰尘。
属于原主的荒唐记忆和穿越者的意识纠缠撕扯，让他太阳穴突突地跳。
他是李家老三.
上面有个老实巴交的大哥李忠。
一个精明能干却快被生活压垮的嫂子王氏。
还有个刚满十五、却黢黑瘦弱，常年吃不饱的妹妹李秀儿。
家里原本的顶梁柱是老爹李山，十里八乡有名的好猎手。
可半年前，李山为了给这个最宠爱的小儿子猎张好狐皮讨好镇上的徐小娘子。
追进了深山，摔断了腿，落了病根，再也进不了山。
原主李玄呢？

从小被宠着，身板单薄，吃不了苦，却学了一身镇上泼皮的做派。
他觉得山里人家穷酸，父亲没用，大哥窝囊。
一心只想攀上镇里杂货铺徐掌柜的女儿，觉得那才是“良配”
家里越是艰难，他越是变着法儿从家里抠钱去讨好徐小娘子。
对父兄的劝告非打即骂。
对嫂子的抱怨嗤之以鼻，对妹妹的处境漠不关心。
昨天，他确实偷了鸡蛋去镇上。
可惜连徐家后门都没能靠近，就被伙计赶了回来。
原主又气又恼，回家倒头就睡。
夜里就发了场高烧，再醒来，壳子里的魂就换了。
外间的争吵和叹息像针一样扎在李玄心上。
不是为原主羞愧，而是为这一家子被拖累的好人感到憋闷和一股子邪火。
“哥，爹喊你起床。”
破旧的门板头面，透出个怯生生的小脑袋。
正是原主的妹妹，李秀儿。
明明已经十五岁了。
可看起来跟半大的小孩却没太大区别。
“日子过得太苦了！
一家人都吃不饱，还有男主这么个老鼠屎……”
“告诉爹，我这就起来。”

他视线落在李秀儿头上，那里浮现着两行极淡、只有他能看见的字迹：
content_en:
It was just dawn, and there were still a few thin wisps of smoke floating over the village.
Li Xuan was awakened by a suppressed sob and the muffled sound of pots and pans being beaten.
It was my sister-in-law Wang's voice, full of tears and resentment:
"...I can't live this life!
The rice vat has bottomed out, and dad's medicine money has not yet arrived. Yesterday, the third child stole the last few eggs from the family and went to town. He must be looking for the Xu family vixen again!
Sooner or later this family will be ruined by him! "
"Keep your voice down..."
The eldest brother Li Zhong persuaded in a sullen voice, his voice full of exhaustion.
This was followed by a heavy cough and sigh from his father Li Shan:
"Oh...blame me, blame me for spoiling him...ahem..."
Li Xuan was lying on the cold earthen bed, and the morning light filtering through the broken window paper reflected the dust flying in the air.
The absurd memories belonging to the original owner and the consciousness of the time traveler were entangled and torn apart, making his temples jump.
He is the third son of the Li family.
There is an honest eldest brother Li Zhong above.
A smart and capable sister-in-law, Wang, who is about to be overwhelmed by life.
There is also a younger sister, Li Xiuer, who has just turned fifteen, but is dark and thin, and often does not have enough to eat.
The original backbone of the family was father Li Shan, a well-known hunter from all over the country.
But half a year ago, Li Shan hunted a good fox skin for his favorite youngest son to please Mrs. Xu in the town.
After chasing him deep into the mountains, he broke his leg and became ill. He could no longer enter the mountains.
Where is the original owner Li Xuan?
He was pampered since he was a child. He was thin and could not endure hardships, but he learned the ways of the bad guys in the town.
He felt that the people in the mountains were poor, his father was useless, and his eldest brother was useless.
She only wants to get married to the daughter of the shopkeeper Xu of the grocery store in town, thinking that she is a "good match"
The harder things get at home, the more he tries to find ways to get money from home to please Mrs. Xu.
He would either hit or scold his father and brother for their advice.
He scoffed at his sister-in-law's complaints and was indifferent to his sister's situation.
Yesterday, he did steal eggs and go to town.
Unfortunately, he was driven back by the waiter before he could even get close to the back door of Xu's house.
The original owner was so angry and annoyed that he went home and fell asleep.
I had a high fever at night, and when I woke up, the soul in my shell had changed.
The quarrels and sighs outside were like needles piercing Li Xuan's heart.
It's not that I'm ashamed of the original owner, but that I feel depressed and evil for the good people in this family who have been dragged down.
"Brother, daddy is telling you to get up."
A timid little head could be seen from the shabby door panel.
It was the sister of the original owner, Li Xiuer.
He is obviously fifteen years old.
But it doesn't look much different from a half-grown child.
“Life is so hard!
The whole family doesn’t have enough to eat, and the male protagonist is such a rat…”
"Tell dad I'll get up right away."
His eyes fell on Li Xiuer's head, where two lines of very faint handwriting that only he could see appeared:
